<noinclude><pagequality level="3" user="EncycloPetey" />{{rh|BK. xxi.]|ULYSSES SIGNS TO TELEMACHUS.|285}}</noinclude>bow. I am still strong, and not as the suitors twit me with being. Now, however, it is time for the Achæans to prepare supper while there is still daylight, and then otherwise to disport themselves with song and dance which are the crowning ornaments of a banquet."

{{pline|431|l}}As he spoke he made a sign with his eyebrows, and Telemachus girded on his sword, grasped his spear, and stood armed beside his father's seat.{{pline|434|l}}
